text: Implemented pair construction for between-directed, within-directed, and canonical-undirected designs. Duplicate full keys exclude every ambiguous occurrence and retain indexed source trials; unmatched keys, eligible/selected counts, and storage orientation are explicit. PairScore and four-parameter PairwiseAnalysis retain both keys, typed failures, diagnostics, and provenance. Paired/PairDesign regression suites pass 32 tests on JVM and Scala.js.
